03 / The person behind the pages

Made by an educator who knows the classroom.

Krishna Ranjana More is a mathematics educator, author and founder of Arth Aspire Institute. His 14+ years of teaching across boards, from SSC to IB, shape every resource you see here.

The idea is straightforward: build understanding, reasoning and confidence alongside regular practice.

Take the 2-question level finder above and we'll suggest a starting point. You can also message us on WhatsApp and we'll guide you.

Pre-booking is open now, with the workbooks launching from 1 January 2027.

Yes. Use the school enquiry form and tell us your student count and city.
